thread:
Alex K.: Heads-up: rolling change to audit delivery — adding kms_key_id and rbac_effective_roles to session/grant events. Need customer validation plan + docs. pinging @Diana P. @Ravi S.
Diana P.: ack. timeline?
Alex K.: planned for 2026-03-25 canary -> full. want a customer preview bundle and example events for SIEMs.
Ravi S.: if we add rbac_effective_roles, we must ensure no PII leaks. format question: array of strings or single comma string?
Maria L.: array of strings is easier to map in Splunk/Datadog. e.g. ["admin", "billing:read"]
Alex K.: agreed. sample payload below:
```json
{
  "event_type": "session.grant",
  "user": "user-123",
  "kms_key_id": "projects/prod/keys/abc123",
  "rbac_effective_roles": ["admin", "billing:read"],
  "timestamp": "2026-03-20T16:00:00Z",
  "audit_schema_version": "2026-03-1"
}
```
infra-bot: suggest including audit_schema_version as top-level required field. Also recommend schema minor bump and backwards-compat tests. :robot_face:
Diana P.: yes to versioning. we'll bump minor and add compatibility layer so old parsers ignore unknown fields.
Ravi S.: customer validation plan: 1) sample events, 2) small test harness (curl -> JSON assert), 3) SIEM mapping snippets (Splunk/Datadog). Also need KMS visibility note: should the full key path be included for customer-owned logs?
Alex K.: KMS key ids must be present for tenant logs. For any public/shared samples we should mask parts of the path. Add a redaction policy in the doc.
Maria L.: I'll draft the customer email, samples, and a "what changed" changelog. Want to include example mapping rules for Splunk and a Datadog parser snippet.
sec-oncall: will review for PII exposure and vuln triage. Reminder: schema changes can break log ingestion; add parser-compat tests in CI.
Alex K.: action items: Maria -> draft email + samples by EOD Tue; Ravi -> SIEM mapping snippets; Diana -> update schema & integration tests; sec-oncall -> review redaction + triage. We'll run a dry-run canary on Wed.
Maria L.: noted, will have initial docs + samples up on the shared drive for review.
Diana P.: I'll add the schema PR and include a migration guide in the changelog.
Ravi S.: small ask: add a short FAQ line about "why include kms_key_id" for privacy teams.
Alex K.: good call. add that to the customer-facing doc. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
